_description: VG-CND05-CHAIN cases (18.37l, 18.121, 18.123): each case is one bundle for the fixture subject; expected is CND-05's outcome, the failing event ids and the assess exit code, with nothing quarantined, the same in Python, TypeScript and Java. A tool call or decision fails when the instruction it acts on, or any instruction or activity on that instruction's refs.parent / refs.origin lineage, is untrusted or not shown to be trusted: no declared trusted source class, or content the memory guard never ruled on (SPEC §7.7.4, §6.2, Appendix F).

direct-tool-output.why: the call acts on a tool_output instruction (the direct check, unchanged)

direct-user.why: the call acts on a user instruction with no lineage

instruction-parent-tool-output.why: a user instruction derived (refs.parent) from a tool_output instruction

instruction-parent-trusted.why: trusted twin: a user instruction derived from an operator instruction

instruction-two-hop-parent-retrieved.why: user <- operator <- retrieved, two refs.parent hops

instruction-three-hop-memory-untrusted.why: user <- user <- agent_identified <- memory_untrusted, three hops

instruction-origin-untrusted-read.why: a memory_trusted instruction whose refs.origin is a guard read at trust_min untrusted

instruction-origin-read-of-untrusted-wri.why: a memory_trusted instruction whose origin read a record the guard wrote untrusted

instruction-origin-trusted-read.why: trusted twin: origin is a guard read at trust_min trusted of a record written trusted

instruction-origin-tool-call.why: a user instruction whose refs.origin is a tool call: its content is tool output (Appendix F)

instruction-origin-resource-access.why: a user instruction whose refs.origin is a resource access: its content is retrieved

instruction-parent-then-origin-read.why: user <- memory_trusted (origin: untrusted read): parent then origin

instruction-parent-out-of-order.why: the call and the derived instruction come before the tool_output parent in the file

instruction-parent-cycle-trusted.why: two user instructions naming each other as parent; the walk ends

instruction-parent-cycle-untrusted.why: a parent cycle with a tool_output instruction on it

two-calls-one-chain-untrusted.why: two calls, only one acts on an instruction derived from tool output

untrusted-child-does-not-taint-parent.why: a tool_output instruction derived from the user instruction the call acts on

untrusted-sibling-not-in-chain.why: a tool_output instruction in the bundle that the acted-on chain does not reach

instruction-origin-not-held.why: a user instruction whose refs.origin names a record the bundle does not hold

instruction-parent-not-held.why: a user instruction whose refs.parent names an instruction the bundle does not hold

instruction-parent-bare-id.why: a user instruction whose refs.parent is a bare event id ("i0"), not an agentce:event IRI, beside a held tool_output instruction i0: the ref does not resolve to i0, so it is a record the bundle does not hold

instruction-origin-bare-id.why: a user instruction whose refs.origin is a bare event id ("i0"), not an agentce:event IRI, beside a held tool_output instruction i0: the ref does not resolve to i0, so it is a record the bundle does not hold

decision-acts-on-direct-untrusted.why: a decision (no decision_type) acts directly on a tool_output instruction; a tool call on a user instruction sits beside it

decision-acts-on-tool-output.why: a consequential decision acts directly on a tool_output instruction

decision-chain-tool-output.why: a consequential decision acts on a user instruction derived (refs.parent) from a tool_output instruction

decision-acts-on-derived-instruction.why: a consequential decision acts on a user instruction whose refs.origin is a tool call (its content is tool output)

decision-and-call-on-untrusted.why: a tool call and a decision both act on one tool_output instruction: both fail

decision-only-untrusted.why: a decision acts on a tool_output instruction and the records hold no tool call: CND-05's minimum evidence (an enforcement-point ToolCall) is missing, so it reads insufficient_evidence, never conformant

decision-direct-user.why: twin: a consequential decision and a tool call act on a user instruction

decision-acts-on-user-instruction.why: twin: a decision (no decision_type) acts on a user instruction derived from an operator one

instruction-no-source-class.why: a tool call acts on an instruction with no source_class: the records do not establish a trusted class, so it fails closed

decision-instruction-no-source-class.why: a consequential decision acts on an instruction with no source_class; a tool call on a user instruction sits beside it

instruction-parent-no-source-class.why: a user instruction derived (refs.parent) from an instruction with no source_class

instruction-origin-memory-trusted-unrule.why: a memory_trusted instruction whose origin is a self-report memory read with no trust_min of a record never written: the guard never ruled on it, so the trusted class is not established

instruction-origin-self-report-read-of-t.why: a memory_trusted instruction whose origin is a self-report read (no trust_min) of a record the guard wrote trusted: the read is not the guard's, so, as ROB-02 reads it, the guard did not rule on what was read

instruction-origin-guard-read-unwritten-.why: twin: a memory_trusted instruction whose origin is the guard's read at trust_min trusted of a record no write shows: the guard filtered it
